title: Restricted runs are ordinary runs
statement: For a WordRAM program, any run of $n$ steps from configuration $c$ to configuration $c'$ in which the addresses touched at every step belong to a set $K$ is an ordinary run of $n$ steps from $c$ to $c'$.
hypotheses_covered: A run of $n$ steps from $c$ to $c'$ whose touched addresses all lie in $K$
